about: Shared conflict-check cases, run unchanged by shavtzak/test (Dart) and functions/src/event_conflict_cases.test.ts. Dates are Israel calendar days (yyyy-MM-dd); times are HH:mm on the Israel wall clock; a missing event time is "". The event id is always "evt". An optional customHours {start, end} (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm on the Israel wall clock) is the assignment's own window: the runners pass it as the window the member is judged against, and where it is unreadable or ends before it starts they fall back to the event stretch. A case without customHours passes no window. expectedStretch is the event's stretch as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm on the Israel wall clock, end exclusive.
